title: More than 200 companies sign Trump's 'pledge' to protect consumers from data center price rises - Engadget
summary: The White House has announced that more than 200 entities, including major utility companies, data center developers and 23 Republican governors have signed on to President Trump's Ratepayer Protection Pledge.
